# SoundCloud
> SoundCloud is a music streaming and audio sharing platform where listeners discover tracks and creators upload, distribute, and monetize audio.

SoundCloud combines consumer music streaming with creator tools for artists, DJs, labels, and podcasters. The platform includes uploads, embeds, distribution and monetization programs, creator education, advertising, newsroom updates, and legal policies.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://soundcloud.com/): Stream music, discover artists, and access SoundCloud’s main listening experience.
- [Upload](https://soundcloud.com/upload): Upload tracks and audio files to publish and share on SoundCloud.
- [Charts](https://soundcloud.com/charts/top): Browse trending and top-performing tracks across SoundCloud charts.
- [Discover](https://soundcloud.com/discover): Explore personalized music recommendations, genres, and listening suggestions.
- [Search](https://soundcloud.com/search): Search for tracks, artists, albums, playlists, and podcasts on SoundCloud.
- [Mobile Apps](https://soundcloud.com/mobile): Get SoundCloud mobile app access and platform download information.

## For Creators
- [Creator Guide](https://creators.soundcloud.com/guide): Central hub for creator education, platform tips, and publishing guidance.
- [DJ Guide](https://creators.soundcloud.com/dj): Resources for DJs using SoundCloud to share mixes and grow audiences.
- [Help Center](https://help.soundcloud.com/): Support articles for account management, uploads, playback, and creator workflows.
- [Running Competitions on SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/pages/competition): Rules and guidance for hosting competitions and promotions on SoundCloud.
- [Embed Player](https://soundcloud.com/pages/embed): Documentation for embedding SoundCloud players on external websites.
- [Advertising](https://advertising.soundcloud.com/): Brand and campaign solutions for advertising on the SoundCloud platform.

## Artist Services
- [SoundCloud for Artists](https://artists.soundcloud.com/): Creator services for distribution, monetization, fan insights, and career growth.
- [Distribution](https://artists.soundcloud.com/distribution): Release music to major streaming platforms through SoundCloud distribution tools.
- [Monetization](https://artists.soundcloud.com/monetization): Learn about earning revenue from music on and beyond SoundCloud.
- [Mastering](https://artists.soundcloud.com/mastering): Access automated mastering tools for preparing tracks for release.
- [Fan-powered Royalties](https://artists.soundcloud.com/fan-powered-royalties): Overview of SoundCloud’s fan-powered royalty model for eligible creators.
- [SoundCloud for Artists Help](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001716754-SoundCloud-for-Artists): Support content for artist services, distribution, and monetization features.

## Developer & Integration
- [API Overview](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/guide): Introduction to SoundCloud API concepts, authentication, and usage basics.
- [API Reference](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/reference): Endpoint reference for SoundCloud developer integrations.
- [SDKs](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/sdks): Available SDK resources for building with SoundCloud services.
- [Play Button](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/html5-widget): Widget and player integration documentation for embedded playback.
- [Authentication](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/guide#authentication): OAuth and authentication guidance for accessing SoundCloud APIs.
- [Rate Limits](https://developers.soundcloud.com/docs/api/rate-limits): Usage limits and request constraints for SoundCloud API consumers.

## Support
- [Help Center Home](https://help.soundcloud.com/): Main support portal for listeners, creators, and account troubleshooting.
- [Listener Help](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/115001691207-Listener-Help): Support articles for playback, subscriptions, and listening features.
- [Creator Help](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000172847-Creator-Help): Support documentation for uploads, tracks, profiles, and creator settings.
- [Trust & Safety Help](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000172867-Trust-Safety): Guidance on reporting, moderation, copyright, and account safety issues.
- [Subscriptions Help](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000172887-Subscriptions): Help articles for SoundCloud Go, Go+, and billing-related questions.
- [Copyright Help](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000172907-Copyright): Copyright, takedown, and rights-management support resources.

## Newsroom & Company
- [Newsroom](https://press.soundcloud.com/): Official company announcements, product news, and press materials.
- [About SoundCloud](https://press.soundcloud.com/about): Company background and overview for media and partners.
- [Press Releases](https://press.soundcloud.com/pressreleases): Official announcements covering launches, partnerships, and business updates.
- [Media Kit](https://press.soundcloud.com/media_kits): Brand assets and media resources for press use.
- [Leadership](https://press.soundcloud.com/leadership): Executive team and leadership information for company context.
- [Careers](https://jobs.soundcloud.com/): Job openings and career opportunities across SoundCloud teams.

## Legal & Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://soundcloud.com/terms-of-use): Core terms governing use of SoundCloud services and platform features.
- [Privacy Policy](https://soundcloud.com/pages/privacy): Privacy practices covering data collection, use, and user rights.
- [Cookie Policy](https://soundcloud.com/pages/cookies): Information about cookies and tracking technologies used by SoundCloud.
- [Community Guidelines](https://soundcloud.com/community-guidelines): Rules and standards for acceptable behavior and content on SoundCloud.
- [Content Moderation and Enforcement Policy](https://soundcloud.com/moderation-and-enforcement-policies): Policy describing moderation actions and enforcement processes.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://soundcloud.com/accessibility-statement): Accessibility commitments and information about inclusive platform access.

## Copyright & Enforcement
- [Copyright Policy](https://soundcloud.com/pages/copyright): Overview of copyright rules, infringement reporting, and rights handling.
- [Law Enforcement Guidelines](https://soundcloud.com/law-enforcement-guidelines): Procedures for law enforcement requests and legal process submissions.
- [Report Copyright Infringement](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003452847-Reporting-copyright-infringement): Instructions for submitting copyright infringement notices.
- [Counterclaim Process](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003566468-Submitting-a-counterclaim): Guidance for disputing copyright removals through counterclaims.
- [Trust & Safety](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000172867-Trust-Safety): Safety, reporting, abuse prevention, and moderation support resources.

## Subscriptions & Plans
- [SoundCloud Go](https://soundcloud.com/go): Subscription offering for ad-free listening and offline playback.
- [SoundCloud Go+](https://soundcloud.com/go): Premium listening plan with expanded catalog access and offline features.
- [Subscriptions Help](https://help.soundcloud.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000172887-Subscriptions): Billing, plan management, and subscription troubleshooting articles.
- [Terms of Use for Purchases](https://soundcloud.com/terms-of-use-purchases): Terms governing paid purchases, subscriptions, and related transactions.
- [Promote on SoundCloud Terms](https://soundcloud.com/pages/promote-terms-and-conditions): Terms and conditions for promotional tools and related services.
